title: GYATT
blurb: Escaped from streaming chat, absorbed into the Gen Alpha lexicon, and now impossible to say in front of anyone under sixteen without consequences. Gyatt began as a drawn-out contraction of an exclamation of astonishment and settled into its current role as a reaction to something startling. It is one of the load-bearing words of brainrot vocabulary, sitting alongside rizz and sigma in the same crowded sentence. Deploy the button ironically, anthropologically, or at genuine reputational risk. Adults using it correctly is somehow more alarming than adults using it wrong.
origin: From streamer slang, absorbed into the Gen Alpha brainrot canon.
